With 6 years of working with clients as a healthy lifestyle coach and 4 years as a massage therapist, I am thrilled to be able to share with you some of the practices I utilize and teach my clients to get the most out of life.  I believe that who we are and how we feel is made up of how and what we eat, think and do.

Join me as I talk about eating clean, managing stress, practicing self-care and so much more.
